name: Breakthrough Minerals Limited
summary: Operating as a mining and energy firm, Breakthrough Minerals Limited conducts its activities across Australia and Canada. The company's exploration efforts target a diverse range of valuable minerals, including battery, base, and precious metals, along with gold, copper, nickel, lithium, and platinum group elements. Its key assets include the wholly-owned Errolls Gold Project situated in Western Australia, and the Llama Lithium Project in Québec, Canada, which consists of 135 mineral claims covering an area of 75 square kilometers. Incorporated in 2007, the company was previously known as Intra Energy Corporation Limited until its rebranding to Breakthrough Minerals Limited in December 2024. Its corporate headquarters are located in Sydney, Australia.
